senses.gloss: f. (יָקַד) fire-pot, fragment of a vessel used for carrying fire. Sifra M’tsor., Par. 1, ch. I אי חרס יכול מ׳ וכ׳ from the word ḥeres (Lev. XIV, 5) I might infer that a fragment of a vessel was meant, therefore it says ‘a vessel’.
units: Y. Sot. II, 17ᵈ bot. מאן דמר … לא במ׳ בשניטל וכ׳ he who says … you must not use a maḳḳeda, means a vessel the larger portion of which is missing.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 9a:2">Sot. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של חרס</he> a piece of an earthen vessel, opp. <he>כוסות משובחין</he>; <cite ref="Sotah 32b">ib. 32ᵇ</cite>.
